items.title: AMD Life Science 26.08: A Complete Medical Imaging Stack on AMD Instinct™ GPUs
items.summary: Deep learning and medical imaging are reshaping healthcare, from tumor detection in whole-slide pathology to whole-body segmentation in computed tomography (CT). But a medical imaging workflow isn’t a single step. A slide or a scan has to be read off disk and decoded, fed through a model, and often handed to a clinician to review and refine. To serve this work well, AMD Instinct™ has to accelerate every step, not just one of them.
